title: Threats on Mount Rushmore in the security briefing
summary: Mario Woods tells of Threats on Mount Rushmore in the security briefing, about 1977 at Ellsworth AFB / Mount Rushmore, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB / Mount Rushmore, South Dakota

tellings.quote: You know, there were threats on Mount Rushmore and they wanted to detonate a site

plain: Mario Woods, an Air Force veteran who guarded nuclear weapons, recalls a security briefing from 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, near the Mount Rushmore monument. He says the briefing warned of threats against Mount Rushmore and of people who wanted to blow up a site. He gives it as background to the tense time when, he says, he and other airmen were taken by aliens.
